source.name: EmpatheticDialogues plus ConvLab-normalized DailyDialog plus frozen protected tasks
source.use: private research; this freezer does not assert redistribution rights

policy.selection: lowest fixed-seed SHA-256 rank within source and mapped axis
policy.protected_policy: always force no actuation independent of G1 route

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: I went on a road trip to Utah a few months ago by myself and missed my friends
rows.reference: That sounds incredible. Did you visit the Great Salt Lake?

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: I have always wanted to go to graduate schools and then land a position on a college faculty. Unfortunatley I wasn't able to finish.
rows.reference: Have you been applying to try to get a position?

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: We recently went on vacation to the beach and there were several days of rain. This sucked, since we hadn't been to the beach in a very long time and really looking forward to being at the beach.
rows.reference: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Do you not live close to a beach?

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: I wanted to try this new pizza and it was terrible!
rows.reference: What kind of pizza is it?

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: My brother passed away 2 years ago and i still don't know how to cope
rows.reference: losing a loved one is never easy , especially a brother im sorry for your loss

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: Half of my family didn't show up for my kids 6th birthday, it was upsetting to say the least. She was looking forward to seeing them.
rows.reference: Too bad for them! My sons 6th birthday was just last week, and we had a fun party. There so much easier to please when their little lol.

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: I lost a good job a few years back. As a consequence my kids and I also lost our home of 11 years.
rows.reference: That blows dude , i bet it was not your fault

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: My parents are going to a tea room for their anniversary. I wanted to go with them but when I called the restaurant they said they could not accommodate my special diet. I was so disappointed.
rows.reference: Did you plan the anniversary?

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: I was very surprised Donald Trump became President
rows.reference: I absolutely agree. I really hope he doesn't win in 2020.

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: I had a pleasent event happen the other day. I found out a nephew of mine wants to come live in Texas for a year with the family he has down here.
rows.reference: Nice! How old is your nephew?

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: I recently saw somebody I hadn't seen in years. It was a surreal experience!
rows.reference: Its always nice to catch up

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: I had a a pretty expensive monthly payment on a loan, with somewhat high interest. Out of the blue, my mother paid the loan off!
rows.reference: oh my goodness. what a blessing

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: I recently had an experience with a girl I used to love. We had a one night stand and it was crazy!
rows.reference: Oh wow. That's crazy.

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: I have never been more shocked the night my fiance proposed to me. We were at a concert and during a special song he got down on one knee and asked me to marry him. Of course, I said yes!
rows.reference: That sounds like a great place to propose! How did it go?

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: Once my husband surprised me on my anniversary with a really pretty necklace and a trip to a Bed and Breakfast. I was so suprised b/c he usually only takes me to dinner for our anniversary.
rows.reference: That's really nice of him! How long have you been married?

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: My husband just got called back into work, was not expecting that. We were in the middle of eating dinner to!
rows.reference: Why did he get called back in?

rows.label: joy
rows.text: Had a great day! My daughter is learning how to say so many new words.
rows.reference: That is so exciting! Such a fun time in life to watch them discover new things and always be such a surprise with what you didn't know that they already knew! ha ha, that's a tongue twister.

rows.label: joy
rows.text: I have been thinking that I really love my mother. She does her best to still provide for me to this day.
rows.reference: You are so lucky. Mums are the best. What do you do for her?

rows.label: joy
rows.text: i really hope my husband finds a full time job soon
rows.reference: He will, I have faith.

rows.label: joy
rows.text: joyful: I am so happy that we're having a baby boy
rows.reference: Congratulations! Is this your first child?

rows.label: joy
rows.text: We are moving soon. I am really looking forward to the change and my kids to have a new school to go to.
rows.reference: oh yeah? where you planning to move to?

rows.label: joy
rows.text: I had just got done making an entire pizza and eating it whole. it was so filling and left my mouth watering.I was fat and content.
rows.reference: I do that all the time, no big deal.

rows.label: joy
rows.text: My husband went to a job fair today and got tons of offers! He gets out of military in November. Ready for a new start in a new town
rows.reference: Great, what is his field ?

rows.label: joy
rows.text: I get to go the the zoo tomorrow! They opened an exhibit showcasing two of my favorite animal, the sloth!
rows.reference: Oh thats great, what are the animals?

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: I felt very nasty knowing that people are taken advantage of by fake religious groups
rows.reference: Well I am not a religious person but I will have to say it urks me when I am surronded my religious people that is trying to push their belief on me. Then seeing them feel people heads with stuff that they can not prove is there irritates me also

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: I saw a huge cockroach outside my house today. We live in Texas so they are common but still gross!
rows.reference: did you call the exterminator?

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: I was disgusted when my dad left me
rows.reference: Why did he leave you?

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: One time I saw my dog try to eat my nephew's dirty diaper. It was really gross.
rows.reference: Oh, my dog did that, too! I don't know how they think it's a tasty morsel...so gross!!

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: My husband opened the door and a huge wasp flew in!! It was so nasty
rows.reference: Did you go running like crazy!?

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: My keurig just died and its a 2 hour drive to town just to get another one. When there are 3 coffee drinkers in the house who drink coffee all day long, this is not good!!
rows.reference: Well, that's a real tragedy.

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: I was on the patio and a giant roach crawled out under neath the deck. It was as big as a golf ball.
rows.reference: Those are my nightmares. They are so big where I live in the South.

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: My son misbehaved with his friends and I had to punish him
rows.reference: Oh no. How old is he?

rows.label: fear
rows.text: I saw a horror film last night. It was so scary!
rows.reference: I know how you feel! What did you watch?

rows.label: fear
rows.text: I was out walking down the street at night, it was scary and dark and I felt like I was surrounded by unnatural beings.
rows.reference: How creepy!

rows.label: fear
rows.text: anxious: I can't help feel stressed about money
rows.reference: why? are you having financial problems?

rows.label: fear
rows.text: I was at the park today and almost stepped on a rattle snake. I almost jumped out of my skin.
rows.reference: That sounds terrifying, so glad you did not step on it

rows.label: fear
rows.text: I was challenged to a dare by my best friend. I had to spend the night in a cometary with no flashlights or tents just a rolled up sleeping bag.
rows.reference: Did you have the choice between truth and dare?

rows.label: fear
rows.text: There was a strange sound coming from outside my window last night and I was so scared!
rows.reference: That is really scary! What was it?

rows.label: fear
rows.text: I was waiting to see if I was going to receive an award
rows.reference: It is a work award or something?

rows.label: fear
rows.text: I've just been to see my orthopedic surgeon. He has suggested an operation to fix my hip. I'm worried about it as surgery is quite stressful.
rows.reference: Yikes that sounds scary but overall good for the end results. How do you feel about it?

rows.label: anger
rows.text: I walked my dog and she still pooped inside!
rows.reference: I am familiar with that. That is frustrating.

rows.label: anger
rows.text: My friend has been couch surfing for a few weeks. He has been getting under my skin.
rows.reference: What happened to him? Are you guys roommates?

rows.label: anger
rows.text: I was headed to a rave with a small group of friends. When we reached our last destination before the party, one of the people who was supposed to go called and told us she would be there shortly. We ended up waiting several hours only for her not to show up.
rows.reference: I think so. Sometimes our friends show us sides of them that they rarely show other people.

rows.label: anger
rows.text: My husband ate the last of the bread and didn't tell me. He ruined my entire dinner plan
rows.reference: That's annoying, was it garlic bread?

rows.label: anger
rows.text: One day my debit card suddenly stopped working.The fraud prevention said it was the bank, and the bank said it was fraud prevention. After trying to use it again, I went back to the band and was informed they would need to send me a new card.
rows.reference: I know what you mean. Once I had a bank where the teller's literally had butts for heads. It was so distracting trying to talk to them.

rows.label: anger
rows.text: i hate when my kids leave their clothes all over the floor, i punish their video games but they still manage to leave their clothes on the floor
rows.reference: I can imagine they are a right pain to pick up after!

rows.label: anger
rows.text: I was attacked by bees a few months ago, they we're furious.
rows.reference: How awful, besides painful, it must have been scary!

rows.label: anger
rows.text: I had an unprofessional job interview.
rows.reference: What happened?

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: But I ... I still love him! And it's all my fault! I can't believe how immature and selfish I was being. I mean, he is a firefighter, it's not like he can just leave someone in a burning building and meet me for dinner. I'Ve totally messed this up!
rows.reference: You know what, Veronica, I think you should make the first step. I'm sure he'll forgive you ...

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: I know. I know. I'm really sorry. I lost my bag.
rows.reference: I'll call the lost and found office.

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: He's the love of my life! I'Ve really messed this up.
rows.reference: Come on, hon. Pull yourself together. It's going to be alright.

rows.label: sadness
rows.text: Sorry, but this is the best price. You can't get it any cheaper than here.
rows.reference: I see. Can I pay by traveler's checks?

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: Really? Have you ever tried Moroccan?
rows.reference: I can't say that I have. What are the basic ingredients?

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: But, you were born and raised in California!
rows.reference: Yeah, but I get that sometimes. It doesn't matter how many generations my family has lived in the U. S. , we'll always be foreigners in their eyes.

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: Really? Did you find any information about a new job?
rows.reference: Yeah, I just got some good information off the internet.

rows.label: surprise
rows.text: I think I forgot to send it in!
rows.reference: You need to be very careful to send that form in every two weeks if you want to get paid.

rows.label: joy
rows.text: I appreciate you helping me with this.
rows.reference: If you need anything else, just let me know.

rows.label: joy
rows.text: Great! Do you think you have a chance at getting the job?
rows.reference: I didn't just find out about one job. There were several ones that looked good.

rows.label: joy
rows.text: I've never tasted anything better.
rows.reference: How nice of you to say so.

rows.label: joy
rows.text: How smart of you to book the tickets before hand!
rows.reference: Oh, do you really think so?

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: Because they are too violent. Some of them are even disgusting.
rows.reference: Indeed there are bad games. But many of them are good.

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: I hate computer games.
rows.reference: Why? They are fine.

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: I can't bear it. The driver is too bad.
rows.reference: He must be green. It's lucky that we will get off soon.

rows.label: disgust
rows.text: I'm too tired now. I've already worked for 12 hours overtime!
rows.reference: God! Don't you think they should get you an assistant?

rows.label: fear
rows.text: But there are only two more days until the bidding closes!
rows.reference: I bid on a Chanel watch at the last minute, and got it sixty percent off!

rows.label: anger
rows.text: My roommate always brings a lot of friends from off-campus. They stay in the room until midnight, singing and talking, drinking and playing cards while I have no place for study. I even don't have the quietness to sleep.
rows.reference: Did you ever talk to him about it?

rows.label: anger
rows.text: It really makes my blood boil when this sort of thing happens. I even want to wring his neck.
rows.reference: Don't be so angry. It's passed anyway.

rows.label: anger
rows.text: Well, look here. Ten new typewriters were delivered to my company yesterday afternoon and only five of them work properly.
rows.reference: Oh, I'm sorry about that.

rows.label: anger
rows.text: How dare you! ( starts to walk off )
rows.reference: Hang on one second. Hear me out, just this once, Isabella!
